standard.summary: SMC-CFG 是滑动模态 CFG 校正，用于减轻高 CFG 带来的副作用。它是推理功能，不是训练适配器。
standard.effect: smc_cfg_lambda 与 smc_cfg_alpha 控制校正强度和滑动状态更新速度。
standard.whenToUse: 使用较高 guidance 或出现过饱和、细节漂移时进行推理 。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要完全保持旧 CFG 输出，或当前模型族没有 velocity-space 兼容证明时。

standard_en.summary: SMC-CFG is a sliding-modality CFG correction that mitigates the side effects of a high CFG. It is an inference feature, not a training adapter.
standard_en.effect: smc_cfg_lambda and smc_cfg_alpha control the correction strength and how fast the sliding state updates.
standard_en.whenToUse: For inference when using a higher guidance, or when you see oversaturation or drifting detail.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need to keep the old CFG output exactly, or when the current model family has no proof of velocity-space compatibility.

advanced.principle: 在 conditional/unconditional velocity 合成处加入滑动模态校正。
advanced.expectedImpact: 训练时间无变化；推理质量取决于 guidance 区间和模型族。
advanced.tradeoffs: SDXL/SD1.5 输出空间兼容性未证明前不应宣称全路线支持。

advanced_en.principle: Adds sliding-mode correction where conditional/unconditional velocities are combined.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No change to training time; inference quality depends on the guidance range and model family.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Do not claim full-route support until SDXL/SD1.5 output-space compatibility is proven.
